package.description: You don't have to clean your PC for hours or risk your computer crashing if something goes wrong with the cleaning. Placebo Cleaner can (or can not) clean your computer's RAM, drives, registry and gaming-related issues.

en-US.description: You don't have to clean your PC for hours or risk your computer crashing if something goes wrong with the cleaning. Placebo Cleaner can (or can not) clean your computer's RAM, drives, registry and gaming-related issues.
en-US.longDescription:
There are a lot of PC cleaning apps (cleaner, optimizer, system care, tune-up), some work pretty well, some are just scam. But the feeling of relaxation after the end of the cleaning process is priceless. This is where "Placebo Cleaner" comes in.

You don't have to clean your PC for hours or risk your computer crashing if something goes wrong with the clean-up. Placebo Cleaner can (or can not) fix your computer's RAM, drives, registry and gaming-related issues. Actually, a relaxation after the "All issues are fixed!" message will be all you will get, no bits will be harmed.

Placebo Cleaner does nothing but makes you feel good about "cleaning" your desktop or laptop computer. You can enjoy this free utility with friends and family. It can be a good present for April Fools' Day.
en-US.name: Vovsoft Placebo Cleaner
